{{Top}}
{{Quote|We have taken as our calendar 'zero point' the date of the Battle of Yavin, the destruction of the first Death Star, and the first overwhelming victory of the Rebel Alliance.|[[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Historical Council]]|<ref name="TEC">[[The Essential Chronology (real-world book)|''The Essential Chronology'']]</ref>}}
The ''''ABY-BBY' dating system''' was a 12-month/368-day calendar<ref name="DRT">{{Blog|eeusuestornii|7|Don't Read This!!!!!!}}</ref> created by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Historical Council]] following the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Around [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]],<ref name="TEC" /> it became the [[Galactic Standard Calendar|official galactic calendar]],<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|I||A Timeline of Galactic Events}}</ref> replacing the [[Great ReSynchronization calendar]] used during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]].<ref name="GN">{{JournalCite|3|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref> The 'ABY-BBY' dating system differentiated [[Standard year|years]] occurring before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] (designated as '''BBY''') from those following it ('''ABY'''). The New Republic Historical Council chose the Battle of Yavin as its zero point, instead of the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], declaring the former the more significant galactic event.<ref name="TEC" /> This calendar was employed throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] for more than a century and was still in use at the time of the [[Sith–Imperial War]].<ref name="TCSWE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The 'ABY-BBY' dating system was originally known out-of-universe as '''BSW4/ASW4''', which means "before/after [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV]]." The BSW4/ASW4 notation was used in the timeline of the [[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded|second edition of ''A Guide to the Star Wars Universe'']] and ''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''.<ref name="AGttSWU">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref><ref name="TEGtVaV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref> ''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]'' eschewed acronyms altogether and listed dates as '''YEARS''', with 0 YEARS being the events depicted in Episode IV.<ref name="TEGtPaM">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref> The first [[Star Wars: Essential Guides|Essential Guide]] to use the BBY/ABY notation was [[The Essential Chronology (real-world book)|''The Essential Chronology'']].<ref name="TEC" /> This practice continued in [[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']] and beyond.<ref name="TEGtAS">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref>

The 'ABY-BBY' dating system has been widely used out-of-universe, and, although it was not designed as an [[in-universe]] calendar,<ref name="Insider58">{{InsiderCite|58|Star Wars Q&A|''Star Wars'' Q&A}}</ref> ''The Essential Chronology'' ''de facto'' made it one.<ref name="TEC" />
